$comment: GENERATED FILE, do not edit. Change packages/merlon-docs-core/src/config/schema.ts and run pnpm build, which runs packages/merlon-docs-core/scripts/generate-config-schema.mjs.

configVersion.description: Version of @merlon-docs/merlon-docs-core whose config format this file follows.

standardVersion.description: Former name of configVersion, still read until 2.0.0. Use configVersion.

protocolVersion.description: Former name of configVersion, still read until 2.0.0. Use configVersion.

outputDir.description: Generated output root relative to docs root.

outputFile.description: Optional stitched monolith filename relative to outputDir.

compileOrder.description: Guide directories to compile, in order. Leave it out for a tree another tool builds; merlon compile and a full merlon check then fail and point at --no-compile.

sources.description: Which files are documentation and which format reads each. The first entry whose glob matches a file wins.

glob.description: Files this entry covers, relative to the docs root.

format.description: Format that reads them: gfm, rst, text or man, or a registered format id.

roots.description: Entry documents for --no-compile reachability, relative to the docs root (for example index.rst). A file no root reaches is an orphan.

manifestHook.description: Module, relative to the config file, whose default export returns extra reachable docs-root-relative paths, for toctrees a build generates.

sphinx.description: How :ref: and :doc: targets resolve in an RST tree that Sphinx builds.

autosectionlabel.description: Set when conf.py loads sphinx.ext.autosectionlabel, so section titles count as labels.

prefixDocument.description: Mirrors autosectionlabel_prefix_document: labels read docname:Section Title.

maxDepth.description: Mirrors autosectionlabel_maxdepth: deepest heading level labelled; 0 means every level.

ignoreLabels.description: Regular expressions for labels the build generates (genindex, modindex, search, or a project prefix such as abi_.*).

inventory.description: Path to a built objects.inv, relative to the config file. Its std:label and std:doc entries count as defined.

man.description: How --no-compile checks man page references such as open(2). A reference to a page that is neither in the tree nor quieted is a warning, which does not fail the check.

quiet.description: Man page references that resolve outside the tree, so they do not warn: a section such as "8" (also covers 8p), a page or name(section) pattern where * matches anything such as "msr(4)", or "defaults" for sections 1, 2, 3 and 8.

banner.default: <!-- AUTO-GENERATED by Merlon Docs — edit shards, then run: merlon compile -->

sourceTags.description: Wrap each shard's content in HTML source tags indicating its relative path.

path.description: Shard directory relative to docs root (default: {docsRoot}/{name}/).

manifest.description: Manifest file name; review trees use shards.md.

sectionsHeading.description: When set, only links after this ## heading in the manifest set compile order.

title.description: Compile title, injected as a ## heading before the first section.

outputFile.description: Output path for this guide, relative to outputDir or absolute.

includeBanner.description: Put the top-level banner at the head of this guide's output.

sourceTags.description: Wrap each shard in source tags for this guide (default: top-level sourceTags).

hooks.description: Named compile hooks. An array replaces the defaults; an object turns named hooks on or off.

crossGuideLinks.description: How links to other guides are rewritten when this guide is assembled.

ignoreGuides.description: Guides whose shards this guide's links keep as .md paths instead of #slug targets. A link to a shard this guide stitches still gets its in-document anchor.

standaloneGuides.description: Files or globs (relative to scan root) registered as standalone guides: captured by the coverage scan, with no compile output of their own.

gitignore.description: Honor .gitignore when walking for markdown files: the repository root's inside git, the scan root's outside it.

ignore.description: Extra ignore globs beyond the built-in defaults (.git, node_modules, .agents).

root.description: Walk root for the scan (default: invocation directory).

strict.description: Fail merlon check when uncaptured files or missing standalone entries exist.

backup.description: Back up existing compile targets before overwriting them.

ext.description: Suffix appended to each backup file name.

registryFile.description: Slug registry path relative to outputDir.

shardsGlobs.description: Shard lint paths relative to docs root (default: the compileOrder guide directories).

codeExtensions.description: Extra code extensions, added to the built-in defaults. A link or path to such a file must resolve, and a symbol in the link label can cite a line in it, as for a stack the defaults leave out or for workflow YAML.

dataExtensions.description: Extra data extensions, added to the built-in defaults. A link or path to such a file must resolve; its lines are never cited.

searchRoots.description: Extra resolution roots relative to the scan root, tried after it.

generated.description: Scan-root-relative prefixes that are real but absent in a clean checkout: build output, caches, vendor-managed installs. Everything beneath a prefix is covered.

vocabulary.description: Paths this repository documents without having: names the standard defines for a consumer repository, or another project's tree. Matched exactly, so a file beneath one still has to resolve.

review.description: Thresholds for merlon review sprawl signals.

maxIndexEntries.description: Most shard links one index group (links under one ## or deeper heading, or before any) may list before index-size fires.

maxShardWords.description: Most prose words a shard may hold before long-shard fires.

minDuplicateWords.description: Fewest words a paragraph needs before duplicate-paragraph compares it across shards.

guides.description: Per-guide threshold overrides, keyed by compileOrder name or, without compileOrder, by top-level directory of the docs root. Reference pages that are long on purpose get a higher maxShardWords here.

diagnostics.description: Optional split diagnostic file sinks for merlon check, merlon compile, and merlon review.

dir.description: Directory for split errors.txt and warnings.txt files (relative to outputDir or absolute).

errorsFile.description: File path for error-severity diagnostics (relative to invocation directory or absolute).

warningsFile.description: File path for warning-severity diagnostics (relative to invocation directory or absolute).

splitFiles.description: Write errors.txt and warnings.txt under diagnostics.dir (default .caches/diagnostics under outputDir).

title: Merlon Docs configuration
description: Configuration schema for merlon.config.json, the Merlon Docs config file
